# P35.15b — Append-only `technology` claim backfill for ~200k pre-PKG-07 registry subjects (PKG-07b, live leg queued)

**Requirement ids:** **F-329 / F-523** (owned findings — ~232,628 subjects emitted `record_kind="traffic_camera"` with no technology; ~77.4% are ALPR/CCTV/enforcement by their own registry target — this row owns the live fix over the existing subjects) · **NEW-7 / FM-05** (ER substring classification misclassified the largest ALPR group — the backfill writes declared slugs, never inferred ones) · **SIG-TRUST-001** (typed value preservation — the claim carries the declared value verbatim) · **SIG-ONTO-052a/053/054/056** (written slugs are active members of the generated technology registry) · **SIG-STORE-011** (append-only — INSERT-only, no `UPDATE`/`DELETE` path) · **SIG-EVID / §16** (every claim links evidence — the backfill cites the subject's existing captures and mints none on the bound path). **No owned §56 id** — recorded, not invented.
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/275_P35.15b__technology-backfill.md` (manifest row 275) · **Base:** `r11/P35.15a-technology-typing-slug-and-facets` (`809e3fd0`) · **Branch:** `r11/P35.15b-technology-backfill` · **OM-20 posture:** **pre-authorised** — the GATE-G4 11B OM-20 list names P35.15b verbatim (approve-all-19, 2026-10-09T17:32Z; expiry: next gate). The named mutation is an INSERT-only claim backfill — not a §3.3 never-pre-authorised class, the same class P34.21a's listed rights backfill was. The write itself is **paused by the AR-3 freeze** (no hosted write before 2026-10-13 12:00Z) and additionally gated on `live:` P35.15a's hosted `technology` vocabulary registrations — an unregistered predicate would quarantine under P35.14a's closed sink. The leg queues in RETURN PASS per OM-19; **no production mutation ran**.

## Why

P35.15a made every camera-registry target declare its SKOS technology slug and emit the `technology` claim for NEW subjects — but ~200k existing `traffic_camera:<src>:<tgt>:<ref>` subjects carry no technology claim, so the public graph still cannot distinguish an ALPR reader from a traffic-management camera (F-329/F-523). This row lands the backfill half: ordinary append-only claims over the existing identities, driven by the same committed target declarations the emit path reads.

## What ships

- **`db/src/db/technology_backfill.py`** — the plan/apply engine. `plan_backfill` enumerates every keyed `traffic_camera:*` subject (`entity_identity_key`), parses `(source, target, ref)` from the subject key itself, resolves the slug from the caller-supplied `(source, target) → slug` declaration map, and classifies: `pending` (write claim + links), `link_only` (already typed by THIS connector — top links up, interrupted-run convergence), other-writer-typed (untouched), `undeclared` / `malformed` / `no_evidence` (counted, never written — no claim without an evidence link). `apply_plan` writes through `PgClaimSink` (`is_replay`, chunked `commit_chunk_size` commits, closed-vocabulary gate): pending subjects group by their latest *bindable* actual capture (decodable multihash, artifact source = subject source) and `assert_claims(capture=binding)` resolves the ORIGINAL occurrence — no capture/artifact minted; unbindable subjects take the honestly-classified legacy path and still gain real-capture links. A supplementary `claim_evidence` pass adds `establishes` (chosen capture) / `corroborates` (the rest) links, `ON CONFLICT`-convergent, batched commits. The run records an `ingest_run` (`connector_name='technology-backfill'`, replay) plus an `ok` completion with its counts — auditable as a run, not invisible batch SQL.
- **Claim shape** — an ordinary `sig.assertion/1` row: `technology` = the target's declared slug verbatim (value + raw), `derived_from_claim_ids` citing the subject's registry-record claims, `assertion_rationale` naming P35.15b and the no-inference rule, `extraction_method='declared_technology_backfill'`, the target's `license_spdx` + the production per-source rights resolver — labelled backfill-derived, never passed off as connector-fresh.
- **`sig-connectors technology-backfill --dsn … [--apply] [--commit-chunk-size N] [--code-commit sha]`** — dry-run by default: prints the full JSON plan (per-target/per-slug counts, skipped classes, registration precheck) and writes nothing; `--apply` executes the same plan. The declared map and licences come from `dot_511.target_table()` — the same registry the emit path reads — and `target_technology_violations()` fails closed before any DSN is touched.
- **Refusal, not quarantine** — `--apply` checks `technology` ∈ `vocab_predicate` and `camera_registry` ∈ `vocab_artifact_genre` before writing: a missing hosted registration refuses the leg (the ticket's voided-by) instead of landing 200k `unknown_predicate` rows.
